name: zinput_keyboard_suspend
description: zInput::Keyboard_Suspend sets the keyboard suspend flag bit.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence validates this no-callee leaf ORs the keyboard suspend flag with the suspend bit.
The native smoke verifies mouse, joystick, and keyboard suspend setters make the corresponding IsUnsuspended helpers return false.
